dispatch.instruction: The 6:20 PM EDT invocation must claim and execute R3-A1-RR-CI-RECOVERY. It must not HOLD because Worker 2 missed 6:10, because the assignment's intended role differs, or because an earlier test failed. Every proven failure must activate R3-A2 with exact evidence.

assignments.mandatoryAction: Claim the lease and execute now. Do not return HOLD for missed prior slots, nominal-role mismatch, or an earlier failed test.

assignments.fallbackWork: If workflow dispatch is unavailable, add a guarded temporary exact-head workflow, record the run, and remove temporary machinery after authoritative clean-head execution.

assignments.goal: Repair only defects proven by R3-A1, rerun focused exact-head tests, and preserve safety invariants.
assignments.activationRule: If A1 passes fully, mark this not-needed and activate A3. If A1 fails, rewrite this assignment with the exact failing test, head, run/job IDs, logs, and reproduction command, then make it ready before releasing the lease.

assignments.goal: Falsify the passing exact-head result, verify no stale or synthetic evidence is substituted, and certify or reopen the earliest proven gap.
